name: 睡前

steps.name: base
steps.prompt: Edit the attached image of the same anime woman (an adult woman in her mid twenties, same face, same eyes, same dark brown-black hair colour, same art style and lighting). {frame} {only_her} {transparent} Change only her outfit, hairstyle and pose as follows: a cosy bedtime look: an oversized soft white sleep T-shirt slipping slightly off one shoulder, hair loosely tied in a low side ponytail with a few loose strands, thin round glasses; both forearms folded in front of her at the bottom of the frame, her cheek resting on her arms, face turned toward the viewer, relaxed sleepy gentle smile.

notes: Seeded from the first run: neutral is candidate 1 of 2. The 'sleepy' face is sometimes refused by the safety filter; keep the one that passed.
